name: Podcast Tycoon 🎙️
desc:
Welcome to Podcast Tycoon! 🎙️

After being bullied for being a poor unemployed bum, it is time to prove the World #1 Podcaster wrong and start your own Podcast, go from homeless to billionaire in this groundbreaking, Podcast Tycoon game!

Join 'ALT Thug & Co.' to unlock a 20% MORE CASH! 💸
